objective: Execute the complete Rigby verifiable-goal catalog, with evidence-backed milestone commits/PRs and explicit subgoal completion announcements.

goals.title: Establish the executable baseline and protect existing capabilities

criteria.requirement: Reproduce the review probes at a recorded commit, then fix the Windows hash-test environment issue without changing hashing semantics; core and any-robot suites pass with no new skips or weakened assertions.

Record the selected humanoid and frontend suites, existing expected failures, basic drawer acceptance, and gesture/finger export smoke checks. A green expected-failure test is never counted as task success.
Correct stale capability/sensor/collision descriptions and the zoo manifest robot count; map every active acceptance requirement to measured, deferred, failed or out-of-scope evidence.

goals.supported_scope: Executable baseline and explicit acceptance gaps only; no new robot manipulation capability.

goals.title: Make every major result replayable and visually inspectable

criteria.requirement: Create the evidence-bundle contract described below and a single runner that can simulate, verify, render, and re-render recorded trajectories offline.
Demonstrate one success, one runtime failure and one pre-execution refusal; tampering with a trace, model, world or outcome file is detected.

Re-run the six-body canonical prompt three times under pinned dependencies; compare deterministic state/action data while excluding run IDs and wall-clock metadata. Declare any required numerical tolerance before evaluation.

MP4/WebM contains the full episode at real-time playback with timestamps; GIFs are explicitly labeled summaries. Verify that the existing 90-frame render cap cannot silently replace a full-duration video.

goals.demo_requirement: D01: baseline success/failure replay, plus a six-body GIF preview and full-duration videos.
goals.supported_scope: Portable full-state recording/replay and complete video evidence for the six-body free-space baseline: five gate successes, one compilation refusal, one declared runtime failure. No manipulation, locomotion, VLM or robustness claim.
goals.review_resolution: Final review found three recordings shared the first prompt reference. Fixed to record each independent prompt run, persist reference/pipeline hashes and compare every observed certification trace. A changed second run is rejected by a regression test. Entire seven-case suite and media regenerated at 2770b0e; final audit passed.

goals.work_basis: Independent replay branch from origin/main; G00 changes do not alter the runtime interfaces it uses. Rebase onto merged G00 before integrating G01.

goals.title: Freeze task contracts, observation boundaries and benchmark protocol

criteria.requirement: Implement separate strict fixed-world and capability-normalized modes. A mutation test proves strict mode rejects world fitting and undocumented semantic substitutions.

Hash resolved non-robot geometry, object dynamics, placements, lighting, goals, physics, start-zone rules and sensor policy; the fixed-world hash remains identical across robot swaps. Declared robot-mounted sensor transforms live in the body manifest.
Register root goals, dwell times, attempt/time budgets, perturbation distributions, feasibility rules, metrics and split policy before scored runs. Do not inspect existing sealed holdout identities.
Keep simulator ground truth in an independent evaluator. Access tests prove the acting policy cannot read privileged evaluator fields; fully observed planning is a separately labeled baseline.

goals.title: Derive a body capability contract automatically

criteria.requirement: Ingest all six zoo bodies and at least three available valid third-party descriptions without robot-ID, joint-name or link-name branches in shared control code.

On an independently checked geometry fixture, derive sites within 1 mm, classify all declared effectors correctly, and identify capability/limit/inertia problems by typed error; separately retain existing sealed-label accuracy requirements.
Record geometry, actuation, contact and sensor assumptions with provenance and uncertainty. Unknown grip, suction, rolling or balance ability must not be inferred from appearance alone.
Joint/link renaming and ordering changes preserve capabilities and transform-equivalent motion; include at least 20 renamings/permutations per zoo body.

goals.demo_requirement: D03: automated body inspection gallery showing inferred chains, effectors, workspace and named unsupported capabilities.

goals.title: Verify semantic fidelity beyond identical hashes

criteria.requirement: Freeze 60 shared semantic cases spanning the inventory, reference frames, qualitative extent/speed, repetition and object roles; corresponding requested semantic programs agree across applicable bodies.

Add at least 120 independently authored/reviewed language cases with paraphrases, minimal contrasts, negation, ambiguous deixis and explicit quantities. Canonical symbolic cases must be exact; language correctness target is at least 95%, with all prohibited substitutions rejected.
Preserve '5 cm' as an exact requested quantity while grounding 'a little' from context; verify two distinct body-relative distances without changing the semantic reading.
Publish errors and unsupported language coverage separately. If independent labels are unavailable, complete the engineering fixture but leave the research-language gate pending.

goals.demo_requirement: D04: synchronized 'a little' versus 'as far as possible' versus '5 cm' on three bodies, with the semantic fields and measured distances visible.

goals.title: Close the six-body free-space composition gap

discovered_prerequisites.finding: Reference clock 240 Hz differs from zoo MuJoCo timestep 0.002 s (500 Hz); existing timing/velocity claims require re-evaluation.
discovered_prerequisites.required_action: Use actual physics time consistently, preserve existing physical limits, and independently justify any physically required duration increase before G05 scoring. Do not redefine a slower result as passing by changing timestamps.

criteria.requirement: The exact reviewed reach/return prompt succeeds on all six bodies using freshly generated exact-region primitives, zero substitutions and unchanged limits; left_joint_4 no longer exceeds its range.
For each body, evaluate at least 20 predeclared start/pace variants with at least 19 successful feasible trials; invalid requests produce correct typed refusals and are counted separately.

Retain all current physical gates, report tracking and wall/execution time, and keep canonical durations no slower than the recorded baseline unless a documented physical requirement is independently justified.

goals.demo_requirement: D05: six synchronized bodies performing reach/return, plus the old and repaired dual-arm transition.

goals.title: Make contact primitives physically useful across grippers

criteria.requirement: For every one of the five gripper-bearing zoo bodies, attempt approach, opposition/closure, lift, sustained hold, transport and release. Every enabled body must pass the canonical normalized grasp. Record remaining bodies as failed or independently demonstrated mechanically unsupported, with concrete diagnostics.

On a fixed fixture selected and frozen from the independent feasibility map, achieve at least 90/100 successful trials per enabled body. Completion requires at least three structural/effector configurations, including a bimanual or multifinger configuration, not three length variants of one gripper. An unsuccessful/refused body does not count toward this minimum.

Measure stable object support for at least 2 s, transport into the target region, and stable released placement for at least 2 s; freeze displacement, load and penetration tolerances before evaluation.

No hidden object state writes, welds, object actuators or arm/object collision exclusions may create a successful manipulation result. Invalid source-model collision hulls require documented model treatment.

goals.demo_requirement: D06: acquisition-to-release on all five attempted bodies, including failures; synchronized fixed-world comparison for the enabled set.

goals.title: Implement recursive superprimitive contracts

criteria.requirement: Use one neutral typed contract for leaves and composites: arguments, requirements, initiation, invariants, effects, termination, timeout, recovery, resource ownership and validity context.
Execute Sequence, Selector, Observe, Primitive and bounded RepeatUntil at nesting depth at least 4; represent Parallel with explicit resource conflicts.
Reject cycles, unbounded retries, unknown predicates and incompatible resource ownership; test success, failure, unknown and interruption at each node.
Round-trip persisted definitions without changing meaning; no thumb/finger/arm names are required by the neutral contract.

goals.title: Validate and repair transitions between certified skills

criteria.requirement: Check terminal/initiation compatibility for pose, velocity, contact mode, object ownership, belief freshness and limb/support resources.
On at least 100 frozen feasible boundary cases spanning every enabled body, achieve at least 95 successful composed executions; record transition cost.
Inject at least 40 incompatible boundaries and require every one to be rejected or repaired and re-verified before execution. Include the reviewed dual-arm failure.
Apply continuity requirements appropriate to the contact mode; confirm that a smooth path cannot bypass object-hold or support checks.

goals.demo_requirement: D08: before/after transition repair, including joint-limit approach, carry-to-place and a contact-mode change.

goals.title: Generate observable conditionals and monitor progress honestly

criteria.requirement: Represent each conditional with entities, evidence sources, temporal window, decision rule, uncertainty/abstention and fallback.

Cover at least six predicates: reachable, opposition established, held, moving with robot, stably placed, area clear. Evaluate at least 20 independently labeled episodes per predicate using declared sensors.
On at least 60 cases with occlusion, stale frames or absent sensors, produce unknown/re-observe/failure rather than an unsupported success; no false success in this engineered negative set.
The same predicate contract binds to different sensor configurations without privileged evaluator leakage. Thresholds are set by task policy/calibration, not guessed from URDF text.

goals.demo_requirement: D09: visible grasp, hidden slip and occluded placement, with sensor provenance and pass/fail/unknown overlays.

goals.title: Deliver the first reusable closed-loop TransferObject skill

criteria.requirement: Run one root skill definition through Acquire, VerifyHold, Transport, Release and VerifyPlacement on the frozen enabled bodies and identical physical scene.
At least 90/100 nominal successful episodes per body under a frozen 120 s default episode cap; report cap changes as protocol revisions before evaluation.
For each body, run 20 trials each of displaced object, induced slip and temporary occlusion; recover and finish at least 16/20 in each class, with no false completion across all trials.
Retry budgets are at most 3 per subgoal and execution is resumable from observed state; a recovery does not restart the environment or teleport an object.

goals.demo_requirement: D10: three-body fixed-world transfer, plus uninterrupted slip and occlusion recoveries.

goals.title: Promote, retrieve and reuse skills with validity conditions

criteria.requirement: Promote a candidate only after its independent validation set passes; store definition, body/controller/sensor context, cost and evidence hashes.
Execute the same TransferObject and at least two subskills from persisted storage on three new object/layout instances per enabled body without manual edits; log cache reuse.
Change geometry, controller, sensors, friction assumptions and evidence schema in separate tests; invalidate or revalidate every affected certificate.
Interrupt and restart at at least 10 safe boundaries; reconstruct state from observations and complete or stop explicitly. Do not treat retrieval similarity as proof of validity.

goals.demo_requirement: D11: learn/validate once, reuse in a new layout, then invalidate and repair after a physical-context change.

goals.title: Acquire missing motor skills within a bounded search budget

criteria.requirement: Freeze three acquisition problems in at least two body families before search; at least one requires new contact timing/trajectory/controller parameters rather than only a new sequence or rename.

Starting without a validated implementation, synthesize one through simulation/optimization and store its contract. Default ceiling: 200 attempts or 30 simulator-worker minutes per problem, whichever comes first.
Evaluate on 50 unseen perturbation trials per body/problem; success target is at least 40/50 with all hard gates satisfied and zero manual trajectory edits during acquisition.
Separate instantiation, composition and motor-skill discovery in the ledger. An unsupported discovery hypothesis is a valid reported research result, but does not meet the capability target.

goals.demo_requirement: D12: missing skill → failed attempts → acquired execution → reuse, with search budget and an uninterrupted final trial.

goals.title: Build a calibration corpus from real execution outcomes

criteria.requirement: Collect at least 600 independent source episodes: 300 successes and 300 natural failures, covering at least five enabled bodies and six task/failure families. Mutations are auxiliary and stay grouped with their source.
Reserve 120 success and 120 failure episodes for a sealed evaluation slice; retain at least two morphology identities or one distinct family outside calibration tuning.
Provide full video, sparse/dense sampled views and global-plus-local crops from the same episodes; hide labels, model verdicts and privileged telemetry from judging inputs.
Use independent simulator truth for measurable physical outcomes. Human reviewers resolve semantic/visual ambiguity and record unknown instead of forced labels.

goals.demo_requirement: D13: labeled failure atlas with complete source-episode links, including near successes and occluded failures.

goals.title: Calibrate VLM judging before enabling autonomous termination

criteria.requirement: Freeze model/version/prompt, decision threshold, abstention policy and evidence format before sealed evaluation; compare sparse frames, dense/video evidence, and global-plus-local views at matched call/candidate budgets.

Beat always-accept/reject/first/base baselines; proposed promotion targets are balanced accuracy at least 0.85, sensitivity at least 0.85 and decided-case coverage at least 0.80, with per-body/class results and confidence intervals.

For noncritical semantic termination, require one-sided 95% false-success upper bound at most 5% on the eligible decided failure population; keep unknowns separate and report all-trial metrics. Critical physical termination retains deterministic/sensor checks.

For any stronger per-failure-class claim, collect the required independent sample count; the pooled corpus cannot establish each rare-class rate. Complete oracle/no-VLM/calibrated-VLM downstream comparisons.

goals.demo_requirement: D14: old versus calibrated decisions on the same hidden-slip/near-complete sequences, including abstentions and remaining errors.

goals.title: Demonstrate recursive long-horizon manipulation before mobility

criteria.requirement: Generate ClearWorkArea trees of depth at least 4 for 3, 5 and 10 objects, using shared subskills and per-object grounding rather than manually authored per-instance scripts.
On three frozen enabled bodies, run 50 paired nominal seeds for each chain length; proposed whole-task success targets are 90%, 80% and 60% for 3/5/10 objects respectively, with confidence intervals.

Run 30 paired disturbed seeds per body for 5 objects; hierarchy with recovery should improve full completion by at least 15 percentage points over the same leaves in a flat/no-recovery executor, under equal time and retry budgets.

Root success requires every designated object correctly/stably placed and the work area clear; no averaging successful children over an unfinished root task. Track planning calls and time saved by reuse.

goals.demo_requirement: D15: uninterrupted 3/5/10-object clearance videos with a live tree and a disturbance/recovery example.

goals.title: Build and validate the three exotic mobile embodiments

criteria.requirement: Provide dog-plus-arm, wheeled-biped and rigid segmented octopus-like models with physical/actuator/sensor manifests; these are development/showcase bodies, not automatically held-out research bodies.
Validate inertias, limits, collision geometry, support/contact roles and recoverable initial states. Body definitions may differ; shared task code contains no robot-ID special cases.
Freeze one common feasible world and goal set for the three bodies before policy tuning, supported by reach/support/traction analysis and a labeled expert feasibility baseline.

Record origin and redistribution terms of every asset; procedural models are the default if no preferred models are supplied. The shared task/world remains independent of which locomotion controller later succeeds.

goals.demo_requirement: D16: physical inspection and contact/support tests for all three bodies, including any unsupported maneuvers.

goals.title: Establish independent locomotion control

criteria.requirement: For each body, execute travel, stop, turn and return on the common course in at least 100 frozen trials; at least 90 reach the goal and remain stable for 2 s.
Run 30 predetermined perturbation trials per body with at least 24 recoveries; include traction/support disturbances appropriate to the declared mechanics and report them separately.
Controller logs identify analytic, per-body trained, automatically adapted or shared policy provenance. No root teleportation, artificial support or hidden stabilizing wrench may count as success.
Publish fall, collision, energy, speed, controller latency and time-budget outcomes; locomotion control must work without the high-level language planner.

goals.demo_requirement: D17: synchronized walk/roll/crawl course plus uninterrupted perturbation recoveries.

goals.title: Combine locomotion with manipulation

criteria.requirement: Execute approach object → stabilize → acquire → move while holding → place → return, with the same root contract on the three bodies.
Achieve at least 80/100 nominal full-task successes per body in the fixed world; verify object control during base motion and correct support-resource allocation.
Run 30 disturbances per body distributed over navigation, carrying and placement; at least 24 end in recovery and true completion, with all remaining trials explicitly failed.
Validate shared limbs/support contacts: a limb used to hold an object cannot simultaneously be assumed available for stance without a verified combined controller.

goals.demo_requirement: D18: uninterrupted retrieve-and-deliver on dog, wheels and articulated tentacles, with carrying perturbations.

goals.title: Generate a useful synthetic control dataset

criteria.requirement: Produce a 1,000-episode pilot from at least four development morphologies, six primitive/contact/transition families and recorded disturbance distributions; include at least 20% failure/recovery or near-boundary episodes.
Store actual state, action, reference, contacts, declared observations, body graph, dynamics, seed and independent outcomes. Demonstrate reconstruction of any sampled episode.
Freeze train/development/topology-test splits before generation; no holdout teacher trajectories enter training. Validate coverage and data integrity with a sampled replay audit.

Measure bytes/episode and simulation throughput before scaling. Default local disk ceiling is 10 GiB for research outputs until capacity is reassessed; 10k/100k points are conditional expansions, not required upfront.

goals.demo_requirement: D19: dataset coverage reel with linked full traces and a side-by-side clean/disturbed/recovery episode.

goals.title: Test a small per-body residual tracker

criteria.requirement: Install an isolated reproducible training environment and compare analytic control, a small per-body tracker, and a history-conditioned residual tracker under identical observations and references.
Run at least three training seeds and 100 held-out disturbance trials per selected body; include tracking, task success, latency and effort outcomes.

Adoption target: at least 10 percentage points more disturbed task success or at least 20% lower tracking error, with no material task-success regression and no critical false acceptance; report paired confidence intervals.
Collect corrections on states reached by the learned policy and compare this with clean-success-only imitation. Bound training by a measured pilot budget before continuing.

goals.demo_requirement: D20: identical disturbance replay under analytic and learned controllers, including cases where learning loses.

goals.title: Test a shared controller on unseen topology

criteria.requirement: Expand the dataset to the stated mobile/manipulation scope with variable-size morphology inputs; compare graph/joint tokens, padded vectors and per-body policies.

Use at least three unseen topology families and multiple bodies per family; freeze models and data before revealing test identities. Evaluate at least 100 trials per reported task/body cell over three training seeds.
Report zero-shot results separately from 10-episode and 100-episode adaptation; zero-shot permits no test-body expert rollouts, finetuning or body-specific code.

Adoption target: at least 10 percentage points better zero-shot full-task success than the padded-vector baseline with a paired confidence interval excluding zero, while preserving physical gates and reported control latency.

goals.demo_requirement: D21: first execution on a previously withheld topology, followed by explicitly labeled few-shot adaptation comparisons.

goals.title: Run the controlled research benchmark and ablations

criteria.requirement: Freeze candidate code, seeds, feasible/infeasible task map and independent labels before confirmatory evaluation; use a 6–10-body, 6-task-family, 20-seed pilot to choose and register the final sample design.

Measure all five hypotheses from the research plan: semantic factorization, body-authoring cost, hierarchy/recovery, synthetic control and visual verification. Conditional branches may be reported unsupported/not enabled; they may not disappear from the results table.

Compare equally expressive Talmy/generic representations, same leaves with flat/hierarchical execution, equal-budget language/constraint baselines, measured/manual body adapters, and applicable control/verifier variants.

Publish every per-cell outcome, unconditional and feasible-only success, refusal precision/recall, coverage, chain length, data/compute/manual labor and confidence intervals. Results are grouped by source episode/body; no frame-level pseudo-replication.

goals.demo_requirement: D22: deterministic paired comparison reels linked to every complete benchmark episode, including negative ablations.

goals.title: Build the synchronized research/demo viewer and exports

criteria.requirement: Display physical views, root goal and active subtree, observed/unknown predicates, body/controller provenance, world hash, sim time, interventions and final outcome.
Load evidence bundles offline; scrubbing aligns video/state/tree within one video frame. Selecting any trial, including failure, opens its full episode and rerun command.
Export rigid per-link GLB and round-trip within the existing 1 mm requirement where that export capability is claimed; keep diagnostic video/trace available when an exporter is unsupported.
Preserve existing humanoid Motion Studio/gesture regressions; separate captured execution from editable planned animation in the UI.

goals.demo_requirement: D23: screen recording of opening, replaying, scrubbing and rerunning a success and failure bundle.

goals.title: Deliver the flagship same-room exotic cleanup demonstration

criteria.requirement: Use the identical instruction and world with three designated objects/trays on dog-plus-arm, wheeled-biped and articulated-octopus bodies; generate a depth-at-least-4 task tree with reused subskills.
Run 50 predetermined nominal seeds per body and achieve at least 40/50 full completions under a frozen default 10-minute simulation cap. No human action during an episode.
Run 30 predetermined disturbed seeds per body with at least 24 true full completions; count remaining failures and every retry/intervention.

Use only declared observations for the deployed policy; VLM-only termination is permitted only for the predicates/populations accepted in G14. Publish an oracle-assisted version separately if used. Goal includes stable placement, clear marked region and return to start.

goals.demo_requirement: D24: synchronized uninterrupted three-body cleanup video, short GIF preview, and an offline gallery containing every trial.

goals.title: Package a reproducible research release

criteria.requirement: Produce a capability/claim table linking every statement to code, protocol, quantitative result and replayable media; identify negative and untested findings.

A fresh checkout reproduces a small smoke bundle and re-renders an archived full episode without API calls. Large models/data have checksums, acquisition instructions, provenance and license inventory.
Provide literature/baseline mapping, data/compute accounting, benchmark protocol, limitations and a clear separation of semantic transfer, per-body adaptation and universal control.
Prepare the manuscript/demo package locally. Public publication, repository push or collaborator messaging occurs only when requested.

goals.demo_requirement: D25: final demo reel with captions linking each segment to its uninterrupted run and quantitative claim.

goals.title: Close optional legacy humanoid, RAG and human-preference acceptance

criteria.requirement: Map existing v2 benchmark, human-study, RAG A/B, export and physical-task requirements to real collected evidence rather than synthetic test fixtures; preserve their original acceptance thresholds.
Run the required human preference/calibration study with independent raters and actual records before claiming human agreement; measure retrieval benefit with a controlled no-retrieval baseline.
Re-run button/drawer robustness and other claimed physical tasks; unresolved grasp/container/bimanual cases remain failed rather than being absorbed into a suite pass rate.

goals.demo_requirement: D26: updated humanoid capability reel with measured tasks, supported retrieval benefits and labeled unresolved failures.

goals.title: Transfer one additional embodiment to physical hardware

criteria.requirement: Obtain the actual robot/actuator/sensor specs, validated model, driver interface, workspace constraints and an on-site operator; calibrate physical parameters and observations.
Reproduce a bounded transfer task for at least 30 physical trials, with at least 24 true completions and independent placement/contact evidence; report sim/real discrepancies and interventions.
Demonstrate one bounded recovery and validate stopping behavior before attempting unattended long-horizon tasks; preserve limits and observation contracts.

goals.demo_requirement: D27: uninterrupted real-robot trials and synchronized simulation/real comparisons.

goals.title: Explore compliant or soft embodiments as a separate mechanics extension

criteria.requirement: Define whether the target is compliant joints, a continuum body or fluid interaction, and select an appropriate physical model with measured/validated parameters.
Validate at least three deformation/contact responses against independent reference data before transferring skill contracts.
Execute one bounded acquisition/transport or locomotion task under declared observation/control limits, with separate success metrics and no claim that rigid URDF tests validate soft mechanics.

goals.demo_requirement: D28: deformation/contact validation plus uninterrupted soft/compliant task execution.

goals.title: Test a learned short-horizon reference generator

criteria.requirement: Compare analytic/optimization reference generation with a small autoregressive generator using the same semantic constraints and a fixed feedback tracker.
On at least three body families and 100 held-out reference/task cases per body, record hard-constraint feasibility, semantic fidelity, generation latency and physical success.

Adoption target: at least 20% lower reference-generation latency or at least 10 percentage points greater coverage at equal physical success, with no critical feasibility regression; all references still pass validation.
Separate this model's data/compute and errors from the low-level tracker; human motion data are optional and must not become an undeclared embodiment prior.

goals.demo_requirement: D29: identical constraints realized by analytic and learned references, with resulting physical execution and failure cases.
